report:
Reviewed the full subtyping/coercion claim and all six ordinary implementation associations plus all four test entries. Requirements: successful subtyping preserves representation without a runtime conversion; coercion is selected at an expression coercion site and can change layout; completed Typed IR explicitly records any selected conversion; never-to-any is coercion only.

InferCtx::require_sub accepts identical canonical types, recursively relates shared-reference referents, requires equality for mutable-reference referents, and otherwise uses require_eq. The structural equality helper rejects different skeletons or child counts and recursively equates children. Skeleton decomposition preserves primitive kind, ADT/alias identity and arguments, tuple arity, reference kind, array length, and function signature shape. These accepted relations preserve representation; lifetimes ignored by the special reference relation do not affect representation. Neither relation constructs runtime expression conversions. Inference-variable equalities constrain the eventual type rather than converting a value. Error propagation is diagnostic recovery, not an ordinary differing-layout subtype success.

InferCtx::is_never_to_any_coercion explicitly requires canonical source Never and target other than Never. require_coerce recognizes this only before invoking the ordinary subtype relation; require_sub never recognizes it. coerce_expr retains the original expression on subtype success and allocates NeverToAny for the selected conversion, with a block-tail recursion preserving the block structure. Deferred inference targets are not eagerly bound to Never: other argument constraints determine the target, and finalization defaults still-unconstrained targets to Never. check/expr.rs invokes these entry points at expected arguments, return values, assignments, branch/match results, array elements, field initializers and binding initializers. local_syms/fns.rs applies the declared function return type at the body boundary. check/finalize.rs copies operand and result types to the completed body and preserves NeverToAny unless its final target is Never, where the redundant identity conversion is removed. These files, plus unify.rs and skeleton.rs, now have essential associations so their changes invalidate this review.

The ordinary test never_to_any_is_not_subtyping_beneath_mutable_references requires a mismatch for &mut ! to &mut u32 and checks the actual expected/found diagnostic; its additional rustc-only feature-gate expectation is explicit. top_level_never_coercion_preserves_source_and_result_types observes the source loop at ! and a distinct coercion node at u32, while the ! return case has no conversion. generic_never_coercions_follow_other_arguments_in_either_order checks bool target inference and explicit !-to-bool conversions in both argument orders, and checks unconstrained single<T>(loop {}) becomes fn(!) with no redundant coercion. These assertions would catch never-to-any entering invariant subtyping, erased explicit conversions, eager Never binding, and redundant identity conversions.

The remaining sage_meta::todo::inference_subtyping_and_coercion is a genuine deferred test matrix, not executable verification. Its source-driven never cases are now partially discharged by the three ordinary tests; the stated prerequisite for completing the remaining evidence is focused tests covering every implemented subtype/coercion rule and demonstrating layout preservation, including additional invariant constructors. The placeholder has no assertions and its passing execution cannot establish this matrix. This explicit existing TODO remains visible and is accepted as deferred test coverage, not as a claim that exhaustive representation testing exists. No implementation TODO or N/A entry is present. Source inspection accounts for the representation guarantee under the presently implemented equality/reference subtype rules; it is not a machine-checked layout proof.

Execution: cargo fmt succeeded; cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test inference never -- --nocapture passed all three ordinary associated tests (three passed, five filtered out). Only association comments were added; no behavioral code or expectations changed. Additional workspace build and centralized post-codegen/Sage sanity checks are handled separately by the coordinator. This report is a source assessment and the stated focused run, not an assertion of full workspace test execution.
